greek: Καὶ ἐποίησαν τῇ σκηνῇ δέκα αὐλαίας,

hint: Bezalel son of Uri, of the tribe of Judah, does the work as the Lord ordered Moses.

notes.text: The article as a noun with the genitive, the one of the Uri, as at 35:30.

reading: and [[name:Βεσελεηλ]], the one of the [[name:Ουριου]], [[out of|out of, forth from, from|ἐκ]] [[of race|of race, of tribe, of body united by ties of blood and descent, of clan, of tribe by local habitation, of hundred and county, of contingent furnished by a tribe, of brigade|φυλή]] of [[name:Ιουδα]] [[made|made, did, produced, created|ποιέω]] [[according as|according as and just as, like as if and exactly as|καθά]] [[put in order together|put in order together, drew up and put in array, arranged and organised, concocted, fixed and assessed, ordained and prescribed|συντάσσω]] [[lord|lord / master, the head, master, the Lord, Jehovah|κύριος]] to the [[name:Μωυσῇ]],

names.gloss: (Βεσελεηλ, from Hebrew Bĕṣalʾēl, "in the shadow of God")
(Ουριας, from Hebrew ʾÛrî, from ʾûr, "flame, light")
(Ιουδα, from Hebrew Yĕhûdâ, which the Hebrew of Genesis 29:35 hears in yādâ, "to praise")

greek: καὶ Ελιαβ ὁ τοῦ Αχισαμακ ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Δαν, ὃς ἠρχιτεκτόνησεν τὰ ὑφαντὰ καὶ τὰ ῥαφιδευτὰ καὶ ποικιλτικὰ ὑφᾶναι τῷ κοκκίνῳ καὶ τῇ βύσσῳ.
hint: Eliab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, designs the woven and embroidered work in scarlet and linen.

notes.text: Not in Middle Liddell. LSJ gives it no gloss of its own, "= ῥαπτός", so the senses are Middle Liddell's ῥαπτός, as πόρευσις reads πορεία's at GEN 33:14. Used as a noun, it is headed by the entry's noun sense, ῥαπτόν, an embroidered carpet (Q30).
LSJ, skilful in embroidery: plain. LSJ's embroidery is the feminine made a noun, ἡ ποικιλτική; this is the neuter.
ἀρχιτεκτονέω, to be the architect, then to construct, contrive.

reading: and [[name:Ελιαβ]], the one of the [[name:Αχισαμακ]], [[out of|out of, forth from, from|ἐκ]] [[of the race|of the race, of the tribe, of the body united by ties of blood and descent, of the clan, of the tribe by local habitation, of the hundred and county, of the contingent furnished by a tribe, of the brigade|φυλή]] of [[name:Δαν]], who [[was the architect|was the architect, constructed and contrived|ἀρχιτεκτονέω]] [[the woven|the woven, the brocaded|ὑφαντός]] and [[the embroidered carpets|the embroidered carpets, the stitched and patched, the strung together and continuous, the worked with the needle|ῥαφιδευτός]] and skilful in embroidery [[to weave|to weave, to weave and ply the loom, to contrive and plan and invent, to create and construct|ὑφαίνω]] to the scarlet and [[to the fine flax|to the fine flax, to the linen made from it|βύσσος]].

names.gloss: (Αχισαμακ, from Hebrew ʾĂḥîsāmāk, "my brother has supported")
(Δαν, from Hebrew Dān, which the Hebrew of Genesis 30:6 hears in dîn, "he judged")
